hotels.title: Five-Star Cotswolds Country Estate Elegance at Lucknam Park
hotels.description: Set within 500 acres of private parkland in Wiltshire, this Palladian country-house retreat lies a short drive from Bath’s honey-coloured crescents, the Roman Baths and the boutiques of Milsom Street. Michelin-starred Restaurant Hywel Jones showcases refined British dining, while The Walled Garden serves seasonal dishes in a glasshouse setting. The estate is home to an equestrian centre, tennis courts and a spa with thermal cabins, an indoor-outdoor hydrotherapy pool and treatments by ila and Dr Barbara Sturm. Beyond the gates, explore Castle Combe’s stone cottages and film-set lanes or visit Lacock Abbey, a medieval cloister and National Trust village
